events.title: Sound & Live Composition Workshop: Decoding the Sound of Stones
events.summary: Karen Yu and Hugo Morales Murguía take apart the sound design behind R=Live/Lines — how a moving robotic stone turns into music. Held in English. Free, but you must register online in advance and there are only 20 places.

venue.name: The Lab, East Kowloon Cultural Centre
venue.district: Ngau Tau Kok · MTR Kowloon Bay Exit B

events.title: R=Live/Lines — Sound Performance
events.summary: Robotic stones roam a projected indoor rock garden, leaving trails of light and sound behind them. A five-part sound performance by Kenny Wong, Karen Yu and Hugo Morales Murguía, with a meet-the-artist session after every show. Four performances: Fri 21st 8pm, Sat 22nd 3pm and 8pm, Sun 23rd 6pm. Free seating, so turn up early.

venue.name: The Lab, East Kowloon Cultural Centre
venue.district: Ngau Tau Kok · MTR Kowloon Bay Exit B

events.title: Vision Workshop: Deconstructing the Creative Process
events.summary: Artistic directors Kenny Wong and Karen Yu on the dialogue between human and machine, and what breaks when you try to merge robotics, sound and live performance. Held in Cantonese. Free, but you must register online in advance and there are only 20 places.

venue.name: The Lab, East Kowloon Cultural Centre
venue.district: Ngau Tau Kok · MTR Kowloon Bay Exit B

events.title: R=Live/Lines — Interactive Installation
events.summary: The same robotic rock garden, open to walk through and play with rather than watch from a seat. Free entry, no booking. Wed–Fri 26–28 Aug and Sun 30 Aug, 12noon–7pm; Sat 29 Aug, 2pm–9pm.

venue.name: The Lab, East Kowloon Cultural Centre
venue.district: Ngau Tau Kok · MTR Kowloon Bay Exit B

events.title: Wu-Tang Clan Vinyl Listening Session
events.summary: An intimate vinyl session on how Hong Kong kung-fu cinema shaped Wu-Tang Clan — moving between records, film, swordplay and hard drums. Run by Softerfields, in the basement garage at Heath.

venue.name: The Garage at Heath, 慶方商場 Heath Mall
venue.address: B/F, 36-44 Nathan Road, Tsim Sha Tsui

events.title: Go Ska — The Red Stripes Live Album Release
events.summary: Hong Kong's own ska outfit The Red Stripes play two full sets to launch their new live album, with vinyl selectors keeping the night going after. A solid Friday out in Central for anyone into ska, rocksteady or reggae.

events.title: SoundLab presents: ~jukebox with 龢wo4
events.summary: A sound art improvisation night at CityU's SoundLab — solo and jamming sets from guest artist Brian Chu, plus the launch of SoundLab's jukebox installation, a physical archive of sounds and performances. Free, open to the public, but you need to register in advance.
